integrity: All stated global conclusions follow from an analytic positivity, cooperative-comparison, Perron functional and omega-limit proof. The standalone script verifies exact witness arithmetic only, not infinitely many parameter cases. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only a sufficient global disease-free criterion is proved for deterministic SVEIR models with integer Hill exponent n>=2, all strictly positive rates and vaccine effectiveness in (0,1). No global necessity, time-varying inputs or stochastic claims; the eventual exponential prefactor is initial-condition dependent.
title: An optimized all-Hill-order extinction barrier for vaccinated fomite epidemics
